verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, but the evidence shows no open-source distribution or self-hosted deployment of Statsig's flag platform. Warehouse Native runs analysis in your warehouse, and the SDKs evaluate locally after initialization. Both are adjacent features, not self-hosting the platform, and the docs frame Statsig Cloud as the managed option.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can self-host the full flag platform from an open-source distribution, keeping evaluation data on my infrastructure
